## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name and commit messages follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Loading, empty and error states are handled
- [ ] Works at 360px, tablet and desktop widths
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader accessible
- [ ] Tests were written first, from the acceptance criteria (or the PR explains where TDD did not fit)
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Untrusted data is validated at the API boundary and rendered as text
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass, coverage thresholds hold
- [ ] Docs updated (README, ADR, `docs/api-assumptions.md`) where relevant
- [ ] No secrets, no console noise, no unused code
